record.context_brief: Variational characterization of exponential and mixture connections
record.original_question: Can one characterize the exponential connection and the mixture connection on the statistical manifold of univariate normal distributions through variational problems?

evidence.quote: Characterize the exponential connection and the mixture connection of the statistical manifold of univariate normal distributions by variational problems.

artifact.status_search_result: The question appears as an open problem in a collection of open problems in information geometry (FDIG 2025). While related work characterizes the family of Amari–Chentsov α-connections on normal distributions via conjugate symmetry of curvature, no published variational principle isolating the exponential and mixture connections on the univariate normal manifold was found. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: A characterization of the alpha-connections on the statistical manifold of multivariate normal distributions
status_evidence.snippet: The Amari-Chentsov connection is characterized by the conjugate symmetry, i.e., a curvature identity R=R* of a connection and its conjugate connection.
status_evidence.claim: Existing characterizations of the α-connections on normal-distribution manifolds use curvature/conjugate-symmetry rather than variational principles.
